caption: The drawing is done in black ink or pencil on an off-white or yellowed background, showing a technical top view of a rectangular object measuring 69 1/2 inches in length and 38 inches in width with 2 3/4-inch wide borders on either side. The lower half of the rectangle contains a grid of evenly spaced vertical and horizontal lines, forming rectangles and squares within the main shape. The upper half features several botanical illustrations, including detailed flowers, leaves, and stems, distributed in various areas within this section. Measurements are annotated along the borders, and the words "TOP VIEW" are centered below the object. A scale in inches is depicted at the bottom right, with numbers ranging from 0 to 9. There are also handwritten notations, including a name "B. Hoist: Grubbe" on the lower left. The overall composition combines structural and decorative elements, with both precise technical drawing and freeform floral motifs.
